label: alla: negating an identity rather than an existence
note: Chapter 77. alla was ZERO across the corpus while illa had 27 occurrences, so the track could deny that something was THERE and not that something was SO -- 'I am not a teacher' was unsayable. alla is taught as the negative of aanu, closing a sentence where aanu closes it, and the split is taught as a DECISION English never makes you make: ask which question you are answering, is there any (illa) or is it that (alla).
